item.title: Applications of AI in health care
item.description: I have recently carried out a course in AI in healthcare at the UCL school of management, which has given me an insight into AI and a basic understanding of how algorithms are built and how they can be applied to accurate decision making at scale.

item.title: Medicine & ChatGPT
item.description: Perhaps one of the most astonishing breakthroughs of 2022, when it comes to AI, was the release of the ChatGPT-3 platform launched by the OpenAI company last November. The company already secured a multi-billion-pound deal with Microsoft and generated over 1 million subscribers in less than 5 days. For comparison, it took Netflix 3.5 years to get as many subscribers, 10 months for Facebook, and 5 months for Spotify.

item.title: A guide to… Microsoft Power Automate
item.description: You read about the latest developments in artificial intelligence, meanwhile back to reality, your old IT systems require you to perform repetitive time-consuming tasks. You wonder how can you automate these mundane IT processes? Microsoft Power Automate may be your answer. In this article, I explore Microsoft Power Automate and finish with a simple walkthrough that you can follow in less than 5 minutes.
